newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DCB Bank issues $220 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: DCB Bank issues $220 mln FRCD.

text.p: Malaysia's DCB Bank Bhd said on Friday it has issued a five-year $220 million floating rate certificate of deposit (FRCD).

The issue at a coupon rate of 0.225 percent above USD London Interbank Offer Rate (LIBOR) has an option to the bank to redeem the FRCD at the end of the second and/or third year, DCB Bank said in a statement.
The bank is a subsidiary of financial services firm DCB Holdings Bhd.
The statement said the FRCD would be drawn down on March 20, 1997.
The issuance is part of the continuing effort by the bank to tap the international capital markets for funds, it said.
